questions.sentence: The total cost of the renovation _____ to nearly two million dollars last year.
questions.translation: 去年整修的總花費將近兩百萬美元。
questions.explanation: 句尾有 last year，動詞要用過去式。

questions.sentence: The new medicine passed several _____ trials before it was approved.
questions.translation: 這種新藥在核准前通過了幾項臨床試驗。
questions.explanation: 空格在名詞 trials 前面，要用形容詞修飾。

questions.sentence: Please call the front desk to schedule an _____ with Dr. Chen.
questions.translation: 請打電話到櫃台和陳醫師預約看診。
questions.explanation: 空格前有冠詞 an，要填名詞。

questions.sentence: I would like to make a _____ for four people at seven o'clock.
questions.translation: 我想預約七點、四個人的位子。
questions.explanation: 空格前有冠詞 a，make a reservation 是固定搭配，要填名詞。

questions.sentence: The company plans to _____ fifty additional workers next year.
questions.translation: 公司計畫明年再雇用五十名員工。
questions.explanation: plans to 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: All boxes must be clearly _____ before they leave the warehouse.
questions.translation: 所有箱子離開倉庫前都必須清楚標示。
questions.explanation: must be＋副詞後面接過去分詞，表示被動。

questions.sentence: Attendance at the evening reception is _____, but all staff are welcome.
questions.translation: 晚上的招待會可以自由參加，但歡迎所有員工出席。
questions.explanation: be 動詞 is 後面要用形容詞當補語。

questions.sentence: Please keep your _____ as proof of purchase.
questions.translation: 請保留收據作為購買證明。
questions.explanation: 所有格 your 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: Please _____ two copies of the agenda before the meeting.
questions.translation: 請在開會前把議程印兩份。
questions.explanation: Please 開頭的祈使句，要用原形動詞。

questions.sentence: The annual report was _____ by two senior analysts.
questions.translation: 這份年度報告是由兩位資深分析師撰寫的。
questions.explanation: was＋過去分詞＋by，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: Please read the job _____ carefully before you apply.
questions.translation: 應徵前請仔細閱讀職務說明。
questions.explanation: 空格前的 job 和空格組成名詞片語，被 read 當受詞，要填名詞。

questions.sentence: This is a friendly _____ that the office will close early on Friday.
questions.translation: 友善提醒您，辦公室星期五會提早關門。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a＋形容詞 friendly 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: Our design team will _____ the entire fourth floor starting in May.
questions.translation: 從五月開始，我們的設計團隊將使用整個四樓。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: Customers can _____ by credit card or bank transfer.
questions.translation: 顧客可以用信用卡或銀行轉帳付款。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 can 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: Online sales _____ for nearly half of our revenue last year.
questions.translation: 去年線上銷售占我們營收將近一半。
questions.explanation: 句尾有 last year，動詞要用過去式。

questions.sentence: These products are sold _____ rather than nationwide.
questions.translation: 這些產品是在區域內販售，而不是全國販售。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 are sold、和副詞 nationwide 對照，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: Please _____ all of your travel expenses on the form.
questions.translation: 請在表格上逐項列出所有差旅費用。
questions.explanation: Please 開頭的祈使句，要用原形動詞。

questions.sentence: Visitors are not _____ to enter the laboratory without an escort.
questions.translation: 訪客沒有人陪同不得進入實驗室。
questions.explanation: are not＋過去分詞＋to，表示「不被允許」。

questions.sentence: All fire extinguishers are inspected _____ by a certified technician.
questions.translation: 所有滅火器都由合格技術人員定期檢查。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 are inspected，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: All of our meeting rooms are _____ with projectors and microphones.
questions.translation: 我們所有會議室都配有投影機和麥克風。
questions.explanation: be equipped with 是「配備有」的被動用法，要用過去分詞。

questions.sentence: _____ at the safety training is mandatory for all new staff.
questions.translation: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全訓練。
questions.explanation: 空格是句子的主詞，後面接 at，要填名詞；attendee 是可數名詞，前面需要冠詞。

questions.sentence: Thank you for your quick _____ to our inquiry.
questions.translation: 謝謝您迅速回覆我們的詢問。
questions.explanation: 所有格 your＋形容詞 quick 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: Please _____ the main findings in no more than one page.
questions.translation: 請用不超過一頁的篇幅摘要主要發現。
questions.explanation: Please 開頭的祈使句，要用原形動詞。

questions.sentence: The manager acted _____ when the shipment was delayed.
questions.translation: 貨物延遲時，經理果斷地採取行動。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 acted，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: Our new sales trainer is very _____ and enthusiastic.
questions.translation: 我們新的業務講師非常有活力又熱情。
questions.explanation: very 後面、和形容詞 enthusiastic 並列，要用形容詞。

questions.sentence: The lobby was _____ designed to let in as much natural light as possible.
questions.translation: 大廳是刻意設計成盡量引進自然光的。
questions.explanation: 夾在 was 和過去分詞 designed 中間修飾動詞，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: Only _____ candidates will be invited to a second interview.
questions.translation: 只有被選上的應徵者會受邀參加第二次面試。
questions.explanation: 空格修飾名詞 candidates，表示「被選上的」，要用過去分詞當形容詞。

questions.sentence: Shoppers were invited to _____ the new coffee blend for free.
questions.translation: 顧客受邀免費試喝新的綜合咖啡。
questions.explanation: to 後面接原形動詞（不定詞）。

questions.sentence: It is often difficult to _____ the benefits of employee training.
questions.translation: 員工訓練的效益常常很難量化。
questions.explanation: to 後面接原形動詞（不定詞）。

questions.sentence: Ms. Wu reviewed the contract _____, checking every clause.
questions.translation: 吳小姐有條不紊地審閱合約，檢查每一條條款。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 reviewed，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The factory was fined for _____ the nearby river.
questions.translation: 這間工廠因為污染附近的河流而被罰款。
questions.explanation: 介系詞 for 後面要接動名詞，而且後面還有受詞 the nearby river。

questions.sentence: The job offer is _____ on the successful completion of a background check.
questions.translation: 這份工作的錄取以通過背景調查為條件。
questions.explanation: be 動詞 is 後面要用形容詞，be conditional on 是固定用法。

questions.sentence: Passengers should arrive at the airport two hours before _____.
questions.translation: 旅客應在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。
questions.explanation: 介系詞 before 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: Our engineers are working hard to _____ the problem as soon as possible.
questions.translation: 我們的工程師正努力盡快解決這個問題。
questions.explanation: to 後面接原形動詞（不定詞）。

questions.sentence: Mr. Huang spoke _____ throughout the entire presentation.
questions.translation: 黃先生整場簡報都說得很有自信。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 spoke，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: All workers were _____ to wear helmets at the construction site.
questions.translation: 所有工人都被指示在工地戴安全帽。
questions.explanation: were＋過去分詞＋to，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: All shipments are fully _____ against loss or damage.
questions.translation: 所有貨物都有全額保險，承保遺失或損壞。
questions.explanation: are＋副詞 fully 後面接過去分詞，表示被動。

questions.sentence: The company expects strong _____ in the Asian market this year.
questions.translation: 公司預期今年在亞洲市場會有強勁成長。
questions.explanation: 形容詞 strong 後面、當 expects 的受詞，要填名詞。

questions.sentence: The store offers a wide _____ of office supplies.
questions.translation: 這家店提供種類繁多的辦公用品。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a＋形容詞 wide 後面要接名詞，a wide variety of 是固定用法。

questions.sentence: The conference hall can _____ up to three hundred guests.
questions.translation: 會議廳最多可以容納三百位來賓。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 can 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: _____ to the museum is free on the first Sunday of every month.
questions.translation: 每個月第一個星期日博物館免費入場。
questions.explanation: 空格是句子的主詞，後面接 to the museum，要填名詞。

questions.sentence: The damaged machine was repaired _____ by our technicians.
questions.translation: 損壞的機器由我們的技術人員熟練地修好了。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 was repaired，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: All of the files are numbered _____ for easy reference.
questions.translation: 所有檔案都依序編號，方便查閱。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 are numbered，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The new location is _____ for attracting tourists.
questions.translation: 新地點對吸引觀光客很有利。
questions.explanation: be 動詞 is 後面要用形容詞，表示「有利的」。

questions.sentence: Ms. Park will _____ tomorrow's discussion on the budget.
questions.translation: 朴小姐將主持明天關於預算的討論。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: Several customers _____ about the slow delivery last week.
questions.translation: 上週有幾位顧客抱怨送貨太慢。
questions.explanation: 句尾有 last week，動詞要用過去式。

questions.sentence: All of the paper we use is _____ by a local company.
questions.translation: 我們使用的紙張全部由一家本地公司供應。
questions.explanation: is＋過去分詞＋by，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: The CEO will _____ the merger at tomorrow's press conference.
questions.translation: 執行長將在明天的記者會上宣布合併案。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞。
